description: The Bicycle Infrastructure Network dataset shows cycling infrastructure across Metropolitan Melbourne, Geelong, Ballarat and Bendigo. It was extracted from OpenStreetMap, simplified into high-level categories of cycling infrastructure described in the supporting documentation, and enhanced by Victoria's Department of Transport and Planning to increase the coverage and detail in these regions. Coverage is those four urban areas in Victoria, Australia. Access: free GeoJSON and Parquet downloads with a PDF of supporting documentation from the Transport Victoria open data portal, under the Open Database License because it derives from OpenStreetMap; the entry was last modified in June 2025 and is updated ad hoc. Caveats: the department notes that errors may remain, and rural Victoria is not covered. It supports cycling network topology, route choice and accessibility analysis and the exposure of cycle routes to hazards, and complements the London cycling infrastructure database and the UK National Cycle Network catalogued here.
